# Reprummble

> AI-powered fitness platform connecting workouts, nutrition, sleep, and wearables into one adaptive training plan.

Reprummble helps athletes and everyday fitness enthusiasts train smarter, recover faster, and live stronger. The platform uses AI to build personalised training and nutrition plans that adapt in real-time based on wearable data, sleep quality, and user feedback.

## Key Features

- **Personalised Training Plans** – AI-built programs that adapt to your schedule, gear, and fitness goals
- **Smart Nutrition** – Instant meal logging, macro tracking, and smart food swap suggestions
- **Recovery & Readiness** – Daily readiness scores powered by HRV, resting HR, and sleep quality data
- **Wearable Sync** – Automatic data import from Apple Watch, Oura Ring, Garmin, and Whoop
- **Actionable Analytics** – Weekly insights connecting habits to results
- **30-Day Challenges** – Leaderboards and coach nudges to maintain momentum
